title: Magical Tools
description: This Datapack, best used with datapacks such as STRONG MOBSSS, or Ygdrassil, or more mobs, is going to be best because this gives tools OP abilities such a 3X3 mine or magnet pull, read the description for information about abilities.
body:
⚙️ Custom Ability System – Full Ability Guide

This datapack reworks tools and equipment to give each item a distinct role and purpose, encouraging different playstyles instead of pure stat upgrades. Higher tiers feel stronger, but also more specialized.

⛏️ PICKAXES — Mining & Utility
Iron Pickaxe – XP Miner

Ability:

Mining any block grants bonus XP.

Purpose:

Early–mid game progression tool.

Helps players enchant faster without relying entirely on ores or farms.

Best Use:

Strip mining

Early enchanting

Survival worlds with slower XP gain

Gold Pickaxe – Speed Miner

Ability:

Grants strong Speed and Haste while held.

Purpose:

Raw efficiency and movement.

Gold tools are fragile, but extremely fast.

Best Use:

Clearing soft blocks

Speed mining with beacons

Quick movement underground

Diamond Pickaxe – Excavator

Ability:

When used, breaks a directional 3×3×3 area in front of the player.

Purpose:

Main large-scale mining tool.

Saves time without completely trivializing mining.

Best Use:

Tunneling

Clearing caves

Resource gathering at scale

Netherite Pickaxe – Infinity Gauntlet

Ability:

Large-area excavation

Combat buffs

Item vacuum

Purpose:

Ultimate late-game mining tool.

Feels powerful, but still controlled.

Best Use:

Mega projects

Endgame strip mining

Large survival builds

🪓 AXES — Combat & Control
Iron Axe – Tree Chopper

Ability:

Breaks a 3×5 vertical slice in front of the player.

Purpose:

Dedicated lumber tool.

Removes trees cleanly without nuking terrain.

Best Use:

Wood farming

Large builds

Clearing forests

Gold Axe – Berserker Proc

Ability (on use):

Resistance III

Speed III

Strength IV

Nearby enemies glow

Purpose:

High-risk, high-reward burst weapon.

Gold’s weakness is offset by explosive power.

Best Use:

Short fights

Ambushes

Crowd reveals

Diamond Axe – Crippling Blow

Ability (on use):

Closest enemy is hit with Slowness V.

Purpose:

Crowd control and enemy shutdown.

Makes dangerous mobs manageable.

Best Use:

Boss fights

Tanky enemies

PvE control

Netherite Axe – Infinity Gauntlet

Ability:

Tree Chopper

Berserker buffs

Crippling Blow

Enemy reveal

Purpose:

Ultimate control weapon.

Combines utility, burst, and control.

Best Use:

Endgame combat

Clearing mobs

High-pressure fights

🗡️ SWORDS — Auras & Sustain
Iron Sword – Gravity Field

Ability:

Nearby mobs are heavily slowed.

Purpose:

Defensive control.

Keeps enemies from swarming.

Best Use:

Tight spaces

Early survival

Mob-heavy areas

Gold Sword – Berserker Aura

Ability:

Grants Speed and Strength

Enemies nearby are slowed

Purpose:

Aggressive melee dominance.

Gold rewards constant movement.

Best Use:

Crowd fights

Hit-and-run combat

Diamond Sword – XP Aura Healing

Ability:

If XP orbs are nearby, you heal.

Purpose:

Sustain-based combat.

Rewards active fighting and XP generation.

Best Use:

Mob farms

Long engagements

Dungeon-style combat

Netherite Sword – Infinity Gauntlet

Ability:

Strong self-buffs

Enemy debuffs

Item vacuum

Purpose:

God-tier melee weapon.

Designed for late-game domination.

Best Use:

Bosses

Endgame PvE

Massive mob encounters

🪓 SHOVELS — Movement
All Shovels

Ability:

Grant Speed and Haste while held.

Each tier adds +1 level.

Purpose:

Mobility tool rather than combat.

Encourages switching tools for movement.

Best Use:

Exploration

Terraforming

Traveling while building

🏹 BOW — Stance Weapon
Normal Mode

Ability:

Slow Falling

Speed II

Jump Boost II

Purpose:

High mobility and positioning.

Ideal for ranged combat and traversal.

Sneak Mode

Ability:

Strength III

Nearby mobs get Slowness III

Purpose:

Switches bow into a defensive/combat stance.

Encourages tactical positioning.

Best Use:

Crowd control

Hybrid melee/ranged play

🔱 TRIDENT — Storm Control
Storm Caller

Ability (on use):

Speed III

Strength II

Closest valid enemy within 40 blocks is struck by lightning

Purpose:

Long-range single-target execution.

Trident becomes a true mythic weapon.

Best Use:

Boss fights

High-value targets

Dramatic combat moments

🪽 ELYTRA — Aerial Dominance
Sky God Mode

Ability (while gliding):

Movement buffs

Hostile mobs below are slowed and lifted

Purpose:

Battlefield control from the air.

Elytra feels legendary, not just mobility.

Best Use:

Combat from above

Scouting

Large-scale encounters

🛡️ SHIELD — Defensive Stance
Phalanx Mode

Ability (sneaking with shield):

Resistance II

Nearby enemies get Slowness and Weakness

Purpose:

Tank role support.

Encourages holding ground instead of dodging.

Best Use:

Frontline combat

Protecting allies

Chokepoints

🧠 DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

No item is just “better” — each has a role.

Gold tools are explosive but risky.

Diamond tools specialize.

Netherite tools combine systems.

Encourages tool swapping, not one-weapon gameplay.

When you’re ready, I can:

Balance numbers for PvP

Add lore/flavor text

Create a progression chart

Write in-game advancement descriptions

Optimize performance for servers

Just tell me what you want next.
